nodes.description: Hold ability key to channel to increase the area. When you release, combine all of your minions in the area into a single hulking abomination with states based on which minions are consumed.

For each {Skeleton Warrior} absorbed, your abomination deals more melee damage and has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased attack speed.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, your abomination has increased area of effect.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
nodes.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

stats.statName: Melee Damage and Health per Skeleton Warrior

nodes.description:
Your abomination has additional critical strike chance.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased movement speed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
nodes.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

nodes.description:
Your abomination casts {Aura of Rot}, poisoning itself and nearby enemies every second.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination gains additional chance to inflict poison on hit.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
nodes.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

nodes.description: Your abomination has increased critical strike chance, but can no longer regenerate health or absorb {Bone Golems}.
nodes.altText: The Abomination can still recover health by methods other than health regen.

nodes.description:
If a {Skeleton Warrior} or {Skeleton Rogue} is absorbed, your abomination is granted the ability to {Double Strike} with a 6 second cooldown, dealing significant melee damage.

Double Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Skeleton Warrior or Rogue consumed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
nodes.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

stats.statName: Double Strike Gained on Warrior or Rogue Absorbed
Double Strike Damage per Warrior or Rogue Absorbed

nodes.description: Your abomination's melee hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but can no longer absorb {Skeletal Mages}.

Your abomination can no longer absorb {Summoned Skeletons}.

Minions within 12 meters of your abomination gain increased attack speed.
Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.
Your abomination reflects a percentage of damage to attackers, and disassembles into a number of {Skeletal Vanguards} on death.
Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced attack speed.
Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, but takes damage equal to a percentage of its maximum health each time it uses an ability with a cooldown.
Your abomination's hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.
Your abomination's melee attacks deal damage in a larger area.

If a {Wraith} is absorbed, its melee attack is replaced with {Soul Reave}, which deals melee necrotic damage.

Soul Reave has 200% damage effectiveness compared to the basic melee attack's 150%, and Soul Reave has 15% more radius compared to the basic melee attack.

stats.statName: Soul Reave Gained On Wraith Absorbed

nodes.description: If a {Bone Golem} is absorbed, your abomination uses {Stomp}, a melee attack that deals physical damage and has a high chance to stun enemies in a large area.
Your abomination gains increased attack speed when it kills an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
nodes.altText: Each stack falls off separately.

nodes.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores a larger percentage of its maximum health when devouring other minions.

stats.statName: Percent Max Health Restored on Devour

nodes.description: Your abomination gains more max health (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds each time it devours a minion, up to a limited number of times per 8 seconds.
nodes.altText: Each stack of this effect falls off separately. Stacks are multiplicative with each other.

nodes.description:
If a {Skeletal Archer} is absorbed, your abomination casts {Eternal Arrow} every 4 seconds, a bow ability that deals physical damage and has 100% chance to Recurve.

Your abomination gains additional bow damage per point of your Intelligence.

stats.statName: Eternal Arrow Gained On Skeletal Archer Absorbed

nodes.description:
{Eternal Arrow} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, Eternal Arrow has additional Recurve chance.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
nodes.altText:
Modifiers which add to or subtract from a cooldown, such as this, are applied before increased cooldown recovery speed.

If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

stats.statName: Eternal Arrow Recurve Chance per Absorbed Archer

nodes.description: Your abomination will not devour {Volatile Zombies}, even if they were absorbed to create it.

Your abomination has more health and deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each type of minion absorbed to create it among {Summoned Skeleton}, {Skeletal Mage}, {Wraith}, and {Bone Golem}.
nodes.altText: The maximum benefit of this effect is achieved if the abomination absorbs at least one minion from each of the four types.

nodes.description: If the abomination was made by absorbing at least 1 of every type of minion mentioned by {Engorgement}, it gains more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), increased attack speed, and increased and movement speed.
nodes.altText: If a minion has a different name, it's considered a different type of minion

stats.statName: Attack Speed With All Types Absorbed
Movement Speed With All Types Absorbed

nodes.description: If a {Skeletal Mage} is absorbed, your abomination can cast {Devouring Souls}, a spell that releases multiple necrotic projectiles.

stats.statName: Devouring Souls Gained On Mage Absorbed

nodes.description:
{Devouring Souls} has a reduced cooldown.

Devouring Souls deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each {Skeletal Mage} absorbed.

Devouring Souls releases an additional soul for each Skeletal Mage absorbed.

stats.statName: Devouring Souls Damage per Absorbed Mage

nodes.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with abilities that have cooldowns.
If a {Volatile Zombie} is absorbed, your abomination gains an explosive {Tail Slam} ability.

stats.statName: Explosive Slam Attack Gained On Zombie Absorbed

nodes.description:
{Stomp} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Bone Golem} absorbed, Stomp deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.
When your abomination would devour a minion, it will instead be {Sacrificed}, consuming a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost. This Sacrifice is cast by you and uses your Sacrifice tree.
nodes.altText:
Minions that are Sacrificed will not grant the abomination any benefits that come from devouring.

If Sacrifice chains, it will not chain to the abomination.

If you do not have enough mana to consume, the minion will instead be devoured.

nodes.description: Aerial Assault deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.
After the initial {Wing Burst} your Falcon continues releasing {Featherstorm} at the target location for 5 seconds.

{Featherstorm} now has a chance to slow enemies inside its area each second. 

Additionally, you and your allies have additional dodge rating while inside the area.

stats.statName: Dodge Rating per Dex inside Feather Storm

nodes.description: If there is a boss or rare enemy nearby, Aerial Assault now also creates a {Shadow Falcon} to use {Featherstorm} against it.

Aerial Assault no longer moves you. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it no longer has a minimum range.

Aerial Assault loses its {Traversal} tag.
{Featherstorm} lasts longer and deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second it has been active.
nodes.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments from Featherstorm.

stats.statName: Feather Storm Damage Bonus Per Second

nodes.description: {Featherstorm} now has a chance each second to drop a {Black Arrow}.

{Featherstorms'} base physical damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

A portion of your global poison chance on hit now applies as poison chance per second for {Featherstorm}.

Swaps {Featherstorms'} {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.
A portion of Aerial Assault's cooldown is recovered when your Falcon hits an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

stats.statName: Remaining Cooldown Recovered On Falcon Hit

nodes.description: Using Aerial Assault now also drops {Caltrops} at your location.
{Caltrops} from all sources have a chance to slow on hit and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You now drop additional {Caltrops} halfway through Aerial Assault's movement if you traveled at least 6 meters.

{Caltrops'} hits from all sources have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, when an enemy walks over your {Caltrops} your Falcon's hits gain additional bleed chance scaling with your Dexterity for 4 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

stats.statName: Falcon Bleed Chance per 10 Dex with Buff

nodes.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing mana.
Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of the remaining cooldown of {Falconry} and {Dive Bomb} per 10 maximum mana you have.
Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing health.
Convert the health gain from the {Healing Gust} node to ward at half the effect.

For the next 8 seconds after using Aerial Assault, critical strikes dealt by you or your {Falcon} grant you a stack of {Aerial Prowess} up to a maximum.

When you next use Aerial Assault, it consumes all stacks to restore health per stack and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack.

You have more global dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while traveling with Aerial Assault.

Additionally, each hit you dodge while traveling grants you a stack of {Aerial Prowess}.
Aerial Assault now has a chance to grant you {Aerial Prowess} stacks on non-critical strikes and when you kill an enemy.
Consuming stacks of {Aerial Assault} now grants you {Haste} and Frenzy for a short duration per stack consumed.
Directly using {Ballista,} {Explosive Trap}, or {Dive Bomb} now also consumes your stacks of {Aerial Prowess}, applying the damage bonus to the ability that consumed them.

stats.statName: Aerial Prowess applies to other Abilities

nodes.description: The {Wing Burst's} hits apply frailty.
After landing, all your active {Ballistas} prioritize targets around you, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Intelligence, and gain increased attack speed.
The {Wing Burst} deals damage in a larger area.
nodes.altText: This effect also applies to {Featherstorm}.

nodes.description: The {Wing Burst} deals more direct damage to enemies on high health.
nodes.altText:
Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Aerial Assault.

This direct damage modifier does affect {Featherstorm}.

nodes.description: The damage bonus from {Ambush} always applies against bosses and rare enemies, regardless of their health.

stats.statName: Damage bonus always applies to bosses and rares

nodes.description: When the {Wing Burst} kills an enemy and you have 3 or fewer active {Shadows}, it creates a {Shadow} at that enemy's location.
nodes.altText: This effect also applies to {Featherstorm}.

stats.statName: Shadow Falcon on Feather Burst Kill

nodes.description: A portion of your added, increased, and more throwing damage modifiers now apply to the {Wing Burst}.
nodes.altText: This effect also applies to {Featherstorm}.

nodes.description: The {Wing Burst} now also includes a few {Umbral Blades} that your Falcon throws for you.
nodes.altText: If Umbral Blades throws large blades due to its {Sword Thrower} node, Wing Burst will include half as many Umbral Blades.

nodes.description: The {Umbral Blades'} hits from the {Twilight Strike} node now shred enemy armor.

nodes.nodeDescription: Throw a flask of acid that explodes on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor.

nodes.description: Acid Flask deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Acid Flask has a chance to grant {Haste} on use for a short duration.

When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw 3 Acid Flasks in a line, but Acid Flask costs more mana.

Enemies can only be hit by one flask per throw.
When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw Acid Flasks in a fan in front of you instead of a line. Flasks travel faster.
Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy armor.

Acid Flask leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds that poison enemies that stand in it and adds a 2 second cooldown per flask thrown.

You can have a maximum of 4 {Poison Pools} active at once.
nodes.altText:
{Poison Pool} applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.
This effect can be converted to Frostbite if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

nodes.description: You have a chance to poison enemies while standing in your {Poison Pools}.
{Poison Pools} last longer.
nodes.altText: {Poison Pool} applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

nodes.description:
Acid Flask's base damage is converted to fire damage and its hits deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Acid Flask can no longer apply poison or create poison pools.

stats.statName: No Poison Chance or Poison Pools

nodes.description: Converts Armor Shred from all sources that Acid Flask would apply to Fire Resistance Shred.
When Acid Flask is thrown directly it causes 3 smaller explosions around the impact location dealing fire damage on hit, but it costs more mana.
Acid Flask has a chance to blind enemies hit for 4 seconds.
Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy poison resistance on hit.
nodes.altText: This effect can be converted to cold resistance shred chance if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

nodes.description: Acid Flask has additional chance to poison enemies on hit.
nodes.altText: This effect can be converted to frostbite chance if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.
Acid Flask has increased poison duration.
nodes.altText: This effect can be converted to Frostbite duration if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

nodes.description: Acid Flask has increased throwing speed.

You have a chance to drop an Acid Flask at your feet when an enemy hits you. 

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Chance to Drop Flask When Hit

nodes.description: Acid Flask costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Acid Flask has a chance to slow enemies on hit. Slow caused by Acid Flask lasts longer.
Acid Flask deals additional throwing fire damage.
Acid Flask has a chance to ignite enemies.
Acid Flask has increased critical strike chance and critical strikes deal more damage.
Acid Flask deals damage in a larger area.
nodes.altText: This does not affect {Cluster Bomb}.

nodes.description: Acid Flask travels faster.
Acid Flask penetrates poison resistance based on your own uncapped Poison Resistance
nodes.altText:
This scales off of uncapped poison resistance, so gaining more poison resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect.

Effects which convert Acid Flask's base damage also convert this penetration.

stats.statName: Poison Penetration per 5% Uncapped Poison Resistance

nodes.description: {Poison Pools} have a chance to inflict enemies with {Efficacious Toxin} each second, causing them to take increased damage over time.

Acid Flask is now thrown as a trap that starts arming and explodes when enemies walk over it.

You can have a maximum of 6 Acid Flask Traps active at once.

nodes.nodeDescription: A nova that echoes from enemies it hits and applies abyssal decay. Enemies with abyssal decay take void damage over time for 6 seconds, if they take a hit all the damage from abyssal decay is dealt to them immediately.
nodes.loreText: One day all that will be left of us will be echoes in the abyss

nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Abyssal Echoes' initial burst shreds enemy armor.
Armor shred applied by Abyssal Decay has increased effect.
Abyssal Echoes no longer has a cooldown, but costs more mana.
Abyssal Echoes costs less mana.
Directly using Abyssal Echoes has a chance to cast a {Void Rift} from each nearby {Devouring Orb}.
Abyssal Echoes can now be cast at the target location.
Abyssal Decay has increased duration.
Abyssal Decay now blinds enemies.
Abyssal Decay causes enemies to have reduced physical resistance, but it is no longer consumed when the enemy is hit.
Abyssal Decay causes enemies to take increased damage over time.

Abyssal Decay now deals damage when the enemy is hit, rather than over time. Each hit deals a portion of the full damage Abyssal Decay would have dealt over its full duration. This damage still counts as damage over time.

stats.statName: DoT -> Damage To Enemy On Hit

nodes.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes grants you {Nether Coating} for 5 seconds, granting you increased attack speed with your melee and throwing attacks and causing you to deal more damage to blinded enemies.
{Nether Coating} also grants you a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on hit.
Abyssal Echoes' initial burst consumes all stacks of bleed on the enemy, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.
Abyssal Echoes' initial burst slows enemies.
Abyssal Decay causes Enemies that would apply {Slow} to instead grant their target {Haste} for 1 second.
After casting Abyssal Echoes your next {Erasing Strike} and {Void Cleave} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to slowed enemies.
Abyssal Echoes affects a larger area.
Abyssal Echoes' initial burst has a chance to ignite enemies.
Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now hits and deals spell void damage, but no longer inflicts Abyssal Decay.

Spell void damage from {Potent Corruption}, {Vorpal Reverberation} and attribute scaling is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now also heals you and your allies and nodes on this tree that grant more damage also grant more healing.
Abyssal Echoes' damage now scales with attunement rather than vitality, and its healing effectiveness is also increased by attunement.
Abyssal Echoes deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer chains.
Abyssal Decay now spreads to several nearby enemies after 1 second.
Abyssal Decay spreads to enemies further away and can spread to more enemies when it spreads.
{Abyssal Rifts} cast additional Abyssal Echoes.
Abyssal Echoes now creates an {Abyssal Rift} at the target location that casts Abyssal Echoes for you 3 times at its location before expiring.

Abyssal Echoes can chain additional times. 

This effect is tripled for echoed casts.
Echoed casts deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.nodeDescription: Toggle an aura which poisons yourself and nearby enemies more every second.
nodes.loreText: All things eventually decay...

nodes.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently.
nodes.nodeDescription: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies [8%] more frequently per point

nodes.description:
Aura of Decay is converted to cold, inflicting frostbite instead of poison. Your chance to inflict frostbite applies to Aura of Decay at 100% effectiveness. 

All of its effects related to poison and poison resistance are converted to frostbite and cold resistance. Effects from Aura of Decay which granted less poison damage taken instead grant less cold damage over time taken.

Swaps Aura of Decay's {Poison} tag for a {Cold} tag.
nodes.altText: When converted, Aura of Decay no longer benefits from your chance to poison on hit.

nodes.description: While Aura of Decay is active, you have a chance when hit to cast {Freezing Blast}. This effect has a 4 second cooldown.
Aura of Decay applies Poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but drains mana each second.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies [10%] more frequently per point.

Drains [2] mana per second per point.

nodes.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but also applies poison to yourself more frequently.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies 50% more frequently

Aura of Decay poisons you 50% more frequently

nodes.description: Poison and other ailments inflicted by Aura of Decay last longer. This does not include ailments that slow.

Aura of Decay is converted to physical, inflicting bleed instead of poison. Your chance to inflict bleed applies to Aura of Decay at 75% effectiveness. 

All of its effects related to poison and poison resistance are converted to bleed and physical resistance. Effects from Aura of Decay which granted less poison damage taken instead grant less physical damage over time taken.

Swaps Aura of Decay's {Poison} tag for a {Physical} tag.
nodes.altText:
This node has no effect if {Cold Death} is allocated.
When converted, Aura of Decay no longer benefits from your chance to poison on hit.

nodes.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies every second. A percentage of your chance to shred armor on hit also contributes to this chance per second.
nodes.altText: For example if you have 3 points invested in this node and also have 100% chance to shred armor on hit, this node will grant a total of 105% armor shred chance per second.

stats.statName: Percent of Armor Shred Chance on Hit Contribution

nodes.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to slow nearby enemies every second.
nodes.nodeDescription: Every second Aura of Decay has a [12%] chance per point to slow each nearby enemy.

nodes.description: While Aura of Decay is active, when using a traversal skill or {Evade} you leave behind a {Putrid Bomb}. Putrid Bombs explode after a 1 second delay and Poison all enemies they hit.
Enemies are inflicted with multiple stacks of poison when they hit you, but you also gain poison stacks when hit.
nodes.nodeDescription: Every second Aura of Decay has a [15%] chance per point to chill each nearby enemy.

nodes.description: Allies within range are healed by Aura of Decay each second. Aura of Decay heals more health the less health you currently have.
nodes.nodeDescription: Allies affected by Aura of Decay are healed for [2%] of your missing health per point each second.
nodes.altText: "Allies" includes you.

nodes.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to poison on hit, but are poisoned every second.
nodes.nodeDescription: Minions within the aura are poisoned every second, but also gain 100% chance to poison on hit.

nodes.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect deal more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: Nearby minions have [50%] increased poison damage per point.
nodes.altText: If Aura of Decay is converted to a different ailment, this effect causes minions to deal more damage over time of that ailment's damage type.

nodes.description: You gain {Fester} stacks faster while channeling.
nodes.nodeDescription: Each time you fail to cast Soul Feast, the current chance is increased by 10% of what it already is.

stats.statName: Fester Stack Gain Rate while Channeling

nodes.description:
While Aura of Decay is active and you are stationary, you gain two stacks of {Fester} per second, up to a maximum. You lose two stacks per second while moving.

{Fester} grants your active Aura of Decay more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: Fester does not affect the damage of Aura of Decay's subskills.

stats.statName: Aura of Decay Damage per Stack

nodes.description: When you lose a stack of {Fester} or gain a stack while already at maximum stacks, you fire a {Poison Bolt} at a nearby enemy.

stats.statName: Poison Bolt on Stack Gain at Max Stacks

nodes.description: {Fester}'s maximum stacks is increased, and the rate at which you lose stacks while moving is reduced.
nodes.nodeDescription: Each time you fail to cast Soul Feast, the current chance is increased by 10% of what it already is.

stats.statName: Fester Stack Loss Rate While Moving

nodes.description: You take less poison damage while Aura of Decay is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: You take [2%] less poison damage per point while Aura of Decay is active.

nodes.description: Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less Poison Resistance.
nodes.nodeDescription: Enemies affected by Aura of Decay have [30] less poison protection per point
nodes.altText: This does not apply the {Poison Resistance Shred} ailment, but instead stacks additively with it.

nodes.description: You and Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less poison resistance for each point of intelligence you have.
You have a chance when you would lose a stack of {Fester} to instead gain a stack. Additionally, you lose Fester stacks at an increased rate while moving.

stats.statName: Chance to Gain Fester Stack Instead of Losing
Fester Stack Loss Rate While Moving

nodes.description: Enemies that die within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to emit a {Poison Nova}, which poisons all enemies it hits. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.
{Poison Nova} can occur an additional number of times per 3 seconds.
Aura of Decay has a chance to inflict nearby enemies with {Plague} each second, and Aura of Decay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: Every second Aura of Decay has a [12%] chance per point to apply {Plague} to each nearby enemy.

nodes.description: Aura of Decay affects a larger area.
Aura of Decay has a chance to chill nearby enemies every second.
You have additional poison resistance while in Aura of Decay and you have increased health regeneration if you have deactivated Aura of Decay recently (past 4 seconds).
nodes.nodeDescription: Gain [40%] increased health regeneration per point if you have deactivated aura of decay recently.

stats.statName: Poison Resistance in Aura of Decay

nodes.description:
Aura of Decay consumes mana every 15 seconds to emit a powerful {Defiling Nova}, as long as there is a boss or rare enemy nearby.

This effect occurs with increased frequency based on your uncapped poison resistance.
nodes.altText:
This effect can not be converted to other damage types.

While there is no boss or rare enemy nearby, the cooldown can still recover, but the effect won't trigger or start its cooldown.

Uncapped poison resistance is the amount of total poison resistance you have, ignoring the cap. For example at 3 points invested with 100% poison resistance, this effect will have 60% increased frequency.
Sources of increased cooldown recovery speed do not affect Defiling Nova.

nodes.nodeDescription: You and nearby allies passively have 30% increased damage and +60 elemental protection. Activating Holy Aura doubles the stat bonuses for 4 seconds.
nodes.loreText: Shine like a beacon in the darkness.

nodes.description:
Your melee hits apply 10 stacks of {Fiery Inquisition} and the melee hits of other allies affected by the aura apply 1 stack. If an enemy reaches 60 stacks, the stacks are consumed to release a {Flame Burst}, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

While Holy Aura is active twice as many stacks are applied.

The {Flame Burst} scales with the stats of the player or minion that triggers it.
nodes.altText: Modifiers to chance to apply ailments also modify the number of stacks applied. For example your {Warpath} hits apply 6 stacks, and allies' warpath hits have a 60% chance to apply 1 stack.

nodes.description: If you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: If you are the one to get the final hit on Holy Flame Burst, it deals [50%] increased damage per point.
nodes.altText: {Flame Burst} deals fire damage to surrounding enemies, and is unleashed after successive melee attacks on the same enemy.

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed.
nodes.nodeDescription: Holy Aura gives [4%] increased melee attack speed per point.

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance.
nodes.nodeDescription: [10%] increased critical strike chance per point.

nodes.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies' critical strikes to deal more damage.
nodes.nodeDescription: Holy Aura gives +[5%] critical strike multiplier per point

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased fire and lightning damage.
nodes.nodeDescription: You and your allies have [10%] increased fire damage per point.

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a chance to ignite and electrify enemies.
nodes.nodeDescription: Holy Aura gives +[4%] ignite chance on hit per point

nodes.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies to penetrate enemy fire and lightning resistance.
nodes.nodeDescription: Holy Aura gives +[25] elemental penetration per point.

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased physical damage.
nodes.nodeDescription: You and your allies have [10%] increased physical damage per point.

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased throwing attack damage and increased stun chance with throwing attacks.
nodes.nodeDescription: You and your allies have [12%] increased throwing attack damage and stun chance with throwing attacks per point.

nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional elemental resistance and endurance threshold.
nodes.nodeDescription: Holy Aura gives +[30] elemental and poison protection per point.

This effect puts Devouring Orb on cooldown.

Devouring Orb deals more hit damage to enemies it collides with (multiplicative with other modifiers).

You deal more global void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased mana regen while a Devouring Orb is active.

These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 90 vitality.

Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Area

An enemy cannot be hit by more than once by a single Void Eruption.

The area of the rifts created by the Void Eruption scale with void rift area modifiers from this tree and with Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

Area Increment When Nearby Enemy Dies

However, the new Orb also deals less ailment damage per Orb consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to shred enemy physical resistance to your next bow attack.

Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats.

Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased critical strike chance to your next bow attack.

Using a {Black Arrow} improves your next {Flurry's} base critical strike chance.
Using a {Black Arrow} grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to your next bow attack, but consume additional mana.
Picking up a {Black Arrow} resets the combo of {Cinder Strike}.
Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Cinder Strike} to instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
nodes.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

Consuming at least 3 {Shadows} grants significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Using a {Black Arrow} grants {Puncture} additional physical penetration and bleed chance.
Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional poison penetration and poison chance to your next bow attack.
Additional {Black Arrows} are summoned, but the arrows are summoned at the same frequency causing {Dark Quiver} to have a longer duration.
Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased elemental damage to your next bow attack.
Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to freeze, shock or ignite enemies, depending on the element, to your next bow elemental attack.

Picking up a {Black Arrow} knocks nearby enemies back 4 meters.
{Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.
You instantly summon a number of {Black Arrows} on use. The rest are spread out over the normal duration.
nodes.altText: This does not increase the total number of Black Arrows summoned.

nodes.description: Using a bow attack grants you a chance to summon a {Black Arrow} at a random nearby location. This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Arrow On Bow Skill Use Chance

nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Hail of Arrows} to deal increased damage over time equal to twice your critical strike chance.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} increased attack speed while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.
{Ballistae} that have been buffed by at least 4 {Black Arrows} always critically strike.
Using a Black Arrow grants your next {Heartseeker} additional {Recurve} chance.
Shadows performing Dreamslash have a chance to be resummoned after completing the attack.
nodes.altText: Resummoning a shadow means the shadow is consumed and a new shadow is created at its position.

nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to blind enemies, and deals more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Dreamslash has a chance to inflict {Shadow Daggers} on hit. This is doubled for shadows performing Dreamslash.
Dreamslash has additional critical strike chance.
Dreamslash has increased attack speed, and its mana cost is lower.
Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Dreamslash hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

stats.statName: Critical Multiplier per Shadow Performing Dreamslash

Shadows performing Dreamslash have increased area of effect.

When you directly use Dreamslash and hit an enemy, you have a chance per bleed on that enemy to create a shadow nearby the enemy. This effect has a cooldown.
nodes.altText: If Dreamslash converts bleed to another ailment, this effect uses the converted ailment.

stats.statName: Shadow Creation Chance per Bleed on Enemy

nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

nodes.altText: This does not cause you to create or consume additional shadows. Effects in this tree related to shadows performing Dreamslash do not apply to these throwing skills.

nodes.description:
Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per shadow created in the past 3 seconds, up to a maximum.

Dreamslash now has a minimum mana cost.
nodes.altText: Skills with a minimum mana cost can not have their cost lowered below that amount by any means.

stats.statName: Damage per Shadow Created in Past 3 Seconds

nodes.description: A limited number of shadows performing Dreamslash can consume mana to guarantee being resummoned.
nodes.altText: If a shadow is successfully resummoned by other sources such as {Umbral Recollection}, it will be ignored by this effect.

nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to ignite enemies. This is doubled for shadows performing Dreamslash.

stats.statName: Ward Gained on Hit per Silver Shroud

nodes.altText: Increased attack speed while you have Haste is affected by increased effect of Haste on you.

stats.statName: Refraction Chance when consuming Dream stack

Critical Chance when consuming Dream Stack

nodes.altText: For example with 3 points invested and 100 dexterity, you have 150% increased {Dream} gain rate, resulting in gaining one stack every 0.8 seconds instead of every two seconds.

stats.statName: Increased Dream Gain Rate per 2 Dexterity

nodes.altText: This node has no effect if {Apocalyptic Vision} is allocated.

nodes.description:
Shadows no longer perform Dreamslash.

If you directly use Dreamslash while you are below your maximum {Dream} stacks, you will consume a shadow near an enemy to gain a Dream stack and perform Dreamslash starting from the shadow's location.
nodes.altText:
The use of Dreamslash which consumes a shadow does not consume the Dream stack it generates, but still benefits as if it consumed a Dream stack.

Shadows are not chosen to be consumed if they are not within range of an enemy.

stats.statName: Can Consume Shadow to gain Dream Stack

nodes.description:

While you do not have Dream Aura active, Dreamslash has increased range.

stats.statName: Dream Aura Additional Chance to Receive Critical Strikes

nodes.description:

Directly using Dreamslash can consume a Dream stack to grant the attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and cause it to choose a random nearby target.
nodes.altText: Shadows do not consume Dream stacks when performing Dreamslash, and thus cannot benefit from them.

nodes.description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and frostbite chance from all sources are converted to ignite chance. Chill chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance.
Refracted Dreamslashes can also refract, but the chance is halved after each refraction.

Combo skill. Seals your health at your current amount of health, draining your ward to 0 and preventing you from gaining health or ward for up to 5 seconds. For that duration you gain more damage equal to your percent missing health.

Reactivate to release a wave of death dealing damage based on how long the seal has been active, and percent missing health.

stats.statName: Wave of Death Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance

nodes.description: When Death Seal ends, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

stats.statName: Wave of Death on Reap or Evade

nodes.altText: This node does nothing when cast on a minion.

Mark for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.

nodes.altText: For example you will not apply {Doom Brand} to yourself.

nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing grants elemental and poison resistance.
Your next spell after casting Eterra's Blessing deals increased damage.

stats.statName: Increased Spell Damage On Next Cast

nodes.description: After casting Eterra's Blessing, your spells leech a portion of the damage they deal as health for 4 seconds.

When Eterra's Blessing targets a downed companion, it heals them for a portion of their maximum downed duration.
When you directly cast Eterra's Blessing on a companion it taunts nearby enemies for 4 seconds. However Eterra's Blessing now has a long cooldown.
When Eterra's Blessing is cast on one of your companions, you also heal yourself for a portion of its base heal amount.
Eterra's Blessing automatically targets the lowest health ally in range, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.
When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Spriggan} companion, you are both granted increased spell damage for 4 seconds.
Eterra's Blessing has a chance to heal all allies nearby its target for 50 health.
nodes.altText: The area in which allies are healed is affect by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

stats.statName: Chance To Heal Allies Nearby Target

nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing costs less mana.
Eterra's Blessing knocks back enemies a given distance from its target.
nodes.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the area in which enemies are pushed back, but not how far they are pushed back.

Eterra's Blessing heals half of its value immediately, and half of its value over 4 seconds.
When {Efflorescence's} heal over time expires, heal again for half of Eterra's Blessing's value.
When you are out of mana Eterra's Blessing is free, but Eterra's Blessing can no longer provide additional buffs.

nodes.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

stats.statName: Chance To Summon Healing Totem On High Health Heal

nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing heals for more if you have transformed recently (last 4 seconds).
When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Wolf} or {Bear} companions, you are both granted increased physical damage for 4 seconds.

nodes.description: You regain a percentage of your missing health when you use Lunge.
Lunge deals damage in a wider area along its path.
Lunge gains an additional charge, but it has a longer cooldown.
Other allies caught in the path gain {Haste} for a short duration.
You can now Lunge to other allies.
nodes.altText: You cannot Lunge to shields from {Ring of Shields}.

nodes.description: You now heal allies and cleanse negative ailments on allies you Lunge to. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Lunge now hits all enemies along its path to your target.
nodes.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the width of the path

nodes.description: Lunge hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed along its path but not its final hit.
Lunge deals more damage to enemies along its path and with its final hit.

Lunge's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Voidbringer} node.
You have a high chance to block while Lunging.
Lunge's final hit has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies based on distance traveled up to a maximum.
Lunge's final hit now {Immobilizes} enemies for a short duration.
Improves Lunge's base critical strike chance when using a spear.
Lunge's final hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

Lunge hits instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). The threshold is based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.
After using Lunge you gain additional physical penetration per enemy hit along the path. This buff lasts 4 seconds.
nodes.altText:
This buff can stack if you use Lunge multiple times within 4 seconds.

If Lunge is converted to Void then this buff grants Void Penetration instead.

If Lunge is converted to Fire then this buff grants Fire Penetration instead.

nodes.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to cast {Smite} at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.
nodes.altText: If there are 3 available targets and this effect triggers it will always cast smite at all 3 targets. The cast chance is not rolled individually.

nodes.description: You are invulnerable while Lunging.
Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you {Frenzy} for a short duration.

Lunge's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.
Killing an enemy with Lunge resets the cooldowns of {Void Cleave}, {Erasing Strike}, {Forge Strike} and {Judgement}
Lunge's final hit now deals damage in an extended rectangle instead of a circle when using a spear.

Lunge's final hit now causes you to use {Javelin} when using a spear.

This consumes Javelin's mana cost.

You reduce a portion of Lunge's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Lunge.
Lunge deals more melee damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

nodes.description: You grant other nearby allies {Haste} at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.
nodes.altText: This does not grant you Haste, but does affect your minions.

nodes.description: {Warrior's Renewal} recovers an additional amount of Lunge's cooldown and also grants you health when it triggers.

nodes.nodeDescription:
Manifest Armor
Manifests an animated set of heavy armor, which attacks slowly. Gains the stats of your Body Armor, helmet, gloves, and boots. High mana cost. Lasts until it dies.

nodes.description: Your Manifest Armor gains melee physical damage equal to a proportion of the armour on your body armour.

stats.statName: Melee Physical Damage per 10 Armor On Chest

nodes.description: Manifested Armor has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.nodeDescription: [50%] Increased effect of health regen from all items that affect Manifest Armor.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

stats.statName: Damage Reflected Per Point Of Attunement

nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your helmet.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[75%] Increased effect of stats from your helmet per point.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor deals additional melee and spell fire damage as well as more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Manifested Armor now also attacks with {Forgebreath}, a fire spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies in a cone in front of it. 3 second cooldown.
nodes.nodeDescription: Flamethrower attack in a short cone in front of you.

nodes.description: {Forgebreath} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
nodes.nodeDescription: Forgebreath has [10%] increased range and damage per point.
nodes.altText: {Forgebreath} is a spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies hit.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to ignite enemies.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has a [30%] chance per point to ignite enemies on hit.

nodes.description:
Manifested Armor gains the ability to use {Whirlwind Strike}, a spinning attack which hits all nearby enemies multiple times and travels a short distance. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.
Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your boots.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[75%] increased effect of stats from your boots per point.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to taunt nearby enemies each second.
nodes.nodeDescription: Has a [10%] chance per point to taunt every enemy around it each second.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor cannot be stunned.
Manifested Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through. 6 second cooldown.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifest Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to slow attacking enemies when hit.
nodes.nodeDescription: [50%] Chance per point to slow attackers when hit.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your gloves.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[75%] increased effect of stats from your gloves per point.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor's melee physical attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has a [40%] chance to cause bleeding on physical attacks per point.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor gains [30%] more physical damage over time per point.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to reduce enemy armor.
nodes.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor have a [40%] chance per point to shred armor on hit.

nodes.description: Manifested Armor deals more damage, but has less armor (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Manifested Armor gains a sword which scales with your equipped weapon's stats.

nodes.nodeDescription: Surrounds you with a maelstrom of ice for 8 seconds that deals cold damage each second to nearby enemies. Can be cast multiple times to increase the storm.

nodes.description: Maelstrom deals damage in a larger area.
You can choose to cast Maelstrom on your minions instead of yourself.
nodes.nodeDescription: Can cast on your minions instead of yourself.

nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage when cast on a totem (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: [50%] More damage per point when cast on a totem.

nodes.description: When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.
nodes.nodeDescription:
When your number of Maelstrom stacks reaches 0, you have [10%] chance per point to summon 2 to 4 Twisters (number is random).


The chance is multiplied by the highest number of stacks you've reached.

stats.statName: Chance for Tornado on Direct Cast
Percent of Tornado Mana Cost Consumed

nodes.description: Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.
nodes.nodeDescription: +[20%] Chill chance per second per point.

nodes.nodeDescription: When your number of maelstrom reaches 0, release a tsunami with base cold damage multiplied by your highest stack count.

nodes.description: {Tsunami} deals more damage and has increased area for each stack of Maelstrom on you.
nodes.nodeDescription: [10%] Reduced duration per point. [10%] Increased Maelstrom damage per point. [10%] Increased Tsunami damage per point.

nodes.description: Maelstrom deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), has significantly increased healing effectiveness and lasts significantly longer, but you can have only one maximum stack of Maelstrom.
Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.
nodes.nodeDescription: [18%] Increased damage per point. [10%] Smaller area per point.

nodes.description: Maelstrom has an increased chance to freeze enemies each second.
nodes.nodeDescription: Maelstrom has +[40]% freeze rate multiplier per point.

nodes.description: If you go one second without directly casting Maelstrom you gain a stack of {Lagon's Slumber}. When you next cast Maelstrom directly, all stacks of {Lagon's Slumber} are consumed to cast Maelstrom an additional time per stack.
nodes.nodeDescription: Instant cast. +10 Mana cost. +2 second cooldown.

stats.statName: Extra Casts per Stack of Lagon's Slumber

nodes.description: Maelstrom costs less mana.
Each stack of Maelstrom grants you increased dodge chance.

stats.statName: Increased Dodge Rating Per Maelstrom Stack

nodes.description:
Maelstrom's base cold damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze, but each stack of Maelstrom grants global more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription:
Converts Maelstrom’s base damage to physical.

Each stack of Maelstrom grants 5% increased global physical damage.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze. Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

stats.statName: Global More Physical Damage Per Maelstrom Stack

nodes.description: Maelstrom stacks have a longer duration.

stats.statName: Storm Bolt Cast Each Second At 6 Or More Stacks

nodes.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is doubled if you have at least 60 Attunement.
nodes.nodeDescription: [18%] Increased damage per point. [10%] Increased mana cost per point.

Chance On Hitting Boss Or Rare

nodes.nodeDescription: If you have 6 stacks or more, gain Haste.

nodes.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Frenzy.}
nodes.nodeDescription: If you have 6 stacks or more, gain Frenzy.

nodes.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.
nodes.altText: Maelstrom itself cannot stun, as it is a Damage Over Time Spell.

stats.statName: Global Increased Stun Chance Per Stack

nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: If an enemy is chilled and frozen, both modifiers apply multiplicatively.

nodes.nodeDescription: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing.
nodes.altText: Added damage is applied at 1200% effectiveness
nodes.loreText: A cunning mage can use the power of gravity in more ways than one

nodes.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Meteor has reduced cast speed.
nodes.nodeDescription: [15%] more damage and [5%] less cast speed per point.

nodes.description: Meteor has increased cast speed, but costs more mana. Meteors fall faster.
nodes.nodeDescription: [20%] increased fall speed, cast speed and mana cost per point

nodes.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and even more against enemies at full health.
nodes.nodeDescription: [15%] more damage against enemies on full health per point

nodes.nodeDescription: [34#] chance for the meteor to break into shrapnel on impact per point

nodes.altText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

Meteors deal more damage of all types except fire (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: Meteor deals only fire damage by default, so for this node to have an any effect you must first add non-fire damage from another source, such as an item.

nodes.description: Meteor falls faster.
When directly cast, an additional Meteor falls within a 4m radius of the first, but Meteor costs much more mana.
nodes.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats still only affect the area of effect of each individual meteor, not the size of the area in which they drop.

stats.statName: Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

nodes.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but meteors fall further apart.
nodes.nodeDescription: [15%] more damage per point. The area in which meteors can drop is increased by [15%] per point.

nodes.nodeDescription: Adds [1] additional meteor[s].\n\n[8%] less damage per point.

stats.statName: Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

nodes.description: Meteors fall more frequently. This does not affect the total number of Meteors that fall.

nodes.description: Meteors fall in a line towards where you aim, but Meteor costs more mana.

nodes.description: Meteor costs less mana.
Meteors deals damage in a larger area of effect.

[10%] chance per point for 100% increased area of effect

nodes.description: Meteor critical strikes deal more damage.

stats.statName: Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

nodes.description: Meteor always crits if you have more than 400 mana before you cast it.

After you cast Meteor you recover a portion of the mana spent over the next three seconds. 

You can only recover mana from one cast at once, so if you cast meteor again within three seconds you lose the remaining mana you would have recovered from the first cast.
Casting Meteor grants the {Craterborn} buff, granting additional fire penetration and increased cast speed for a short duration. Craterborn does not stack.
Directly casting Fireball while you have {Craterborn} grants ward and restores your mana.
Meteors cast {Frost Claw} towards a nearby enemy on impact, consuming 120% of Frost Claw's mana cost.
A circular attack that's also used by your shadow clones. Requires dual wielding.
Lethal Mirage deals additional melee physical damage per equipped sword or dagger.
Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.

Lethal Mirage deals additional melee lightning damage and its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Physical penetration from this tree is converted to lightning penetration.

All bleed and poison chances are converted to shock chance.

Swaps Lethal Mirage's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.
Lethal Mirage has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and bleed inflicted by Lethal Mirage has additional Physical Penetration.
Lethal Mirage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.
Lethal Mirage has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target.
Lethal Mirage can now also hit allies granting them the {Mirage Form} buff for 4 seconds, granting bleed chance and additional dodge rating.
nodes.altText: Your Mirages do not hurt allies.

nodes.description: Lethal Mirage now targets allies rather than enemies.
When Lethal Mirage ends you gain {Mirage Form} for 1 second per critical strike landed. This can stack up to 6 seconds.
You gain health and mana per kill with Lethal Mirage.
Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.
Mirages have a chance to leave behind a {Shadow} when they hit an enemy.

On exiting Lethal Mirage's damage window, dash forward again another 6 meters. 

This extends the invulnerability period if invulnerability has not been disabled by other effects.
nodes.altText: If Invulnerability and movement have been disabled, this node provides a short dash with no wait to Lethal Mirage.

nodes.description: Mirages are created faster, causing Lethal Mirage to have a shorter duration.
Reduce Lethal Mirage's cooldown per enemy killed by Lethal Mirage up to a maximum.
Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage dealt as health.
Lethal Mirage consumes all active {Shadows} gaining additional Mirages per {Shadow} consumed, resulting in more hits.
Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.
When you reappear Lethal Mirage releases a burst of smoke blinding enemies and inflicts them with {Frailty}.
The smoke from {Umbral Burst} persists as a cloud blinding enemies and inflicting {Frailty} each second.
Allies within the smoke cloud avoid critical strikes.
The smoke cloud is converted to a poison cloud causing enemies to be poisoned each second, but no longer inflicts {Frailty}.
Poisons caused by Lethal Mirage last longer.
nodes.altText: This includes poison stacks from the poison cloud.

nodes.description: You gain {Haste} when you reappear.
Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.
Mirages have a chance to use {Shadow Cascade} in addition to their normal attack.

Lethal Mirage creates a {Shadow} at the location you disappear from.

This {Shadow} is not consumed by the {Shadow Eater} node.
nodes.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

nodes.description:
Lethal Mirage instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), but can no longer inflict bleed.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.
Improves Lethal Mirage's base critical strike chance, but it has fewer Mirages, resulting in fewer hits.

A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you, returning 10 mana to you for each enemy hit. 

Deals 10 base lightning damage. Added damage applies at half effectiveness.
nodes.loreText: Mana is a mage's most vital tool and his ability to produce it is his most vital ability

Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it kills an enemy, or when it hits a boss or rare enemy.

stats.statName: Mana Instantly Restored on Boss or Rare Hit

nodes.description: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it critically strikes an enemy.

nodes.description: Mana Strike grants more mana gained (multiplicative with other modifiers) from its mana orbs and instant restoration.

Mana Strike has a chance to knock enemies back on hit.

stats.statName: Casts Mana Arc At Positive Mana

nodes.nodeDescription: [5] additional mana gained on hit per point while you are out of mana

nodes.nodeDescription: [15%] increased ward gained on hit per point

When you directly use Mana Strike and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast {Static Orb}. This chance is doubled while you are above 80% mana. This effect can occur up to 3 times per 2 seconds, and consumes 120% of Static Orb's mana cost.

If Mana Strike has a cooldown, this effect is guaranteed.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Mana Strike.

This only affects the echoed Multistrike, not the original use.

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Lightning} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

All sources of poison chance are converted to shock chance for your scorpion, and effects related to poison in this tree instead depend on shock.
nodes.altText:
This node has no effect if {Cold-Blooded} is allocated.

{Shock Nova} deals lightning damage in an area around the scorpion, with 400% effectiveness of added damage.

nodes.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to {Shock} on hit and deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of shock on the target.

Your scorpion has a chance on melee hit to cause a large {Avalanche} boulder to land on the target. The Avalanche boulder uses your scorpion's stats, but your Avalanche tree.

This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

stats.statName: Large Avalanche Boulder on Melee Hit Chance

nodes.description:
Your {Storm Bolts} will strike your scorpion to grant it a stack of {Charged}, up to 20.

Your scorpion's {Shock Nova} consumes all stacks of Charged to deal more damage per stack.
nodes.altText: Storm Bolts will only target your scorpion if it is within 20 meters and has less than 20 stacks of {Charged}.

nodes.description: Your Scorpion deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion deals [30%] increased poison damage per point.

nodes.description: Your scorpion's {Venom Nova} deals damage in a larger area, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion's activated ability, Venom Nova has [20%] increased area of effect and poison chance per point.
nodes.altText: Increased poison effect multiplies poison's damage and its reduction to poison resistance.

nodes.description: {Venom Nova} leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds, which applies a stack of poison each second to enemies standing in the pool.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Venom Nova leaves behind a Poison Pool for [1] second[s] per point.

Poison Pool applies a stack of poison to enemies in the pool each second.

nodes.description: Your Scorpion has a chance when it is hit to create a {Poison Pool}. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
nodes.nodeDescription: Whenever your Scorpion is hit, there is a [10%] chance that a Poison Pool is released on the ground which lasts 3 seconds. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
nodes.altText: Poison Pool applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

stats.statName: Chance To Create Poison Pool When Hit

nodes.description: {Poison Pools} grant you and your minions increased attack speed and cast speed and a chance to poison enemies.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Your Scorpion's Poison Pools give you and your minions +[10%] chance to poison on hit per point.

Your Scorpion's Poison Pools give you and your minions [3%] increased attack and cast speed per point.

nodes.description: Your scorpion has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on hit and its Bleed Chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite Chance.
Your scorpion has additional critical strike chance, and whenever it kills an enemy it restores a percentage of its maximum health.
nodes.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion has +[50] elemental protection per point.
Rips apart an allied minion, dealing physical damage to enemies around it. Added damage applies at double effectiveness.
nodes.loreText: Your minions are created to serve you one way or another

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Sacrifice costs more mana.
nodes.nodeDescription: [15%] increased damage per point. [5%] increased mana cost per point.

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the sacrificed minion has more current health than you.
nodes.nodeDescription: [35%] increased damage if the sacrificed minion had more health than you before you sacrificed it, you monster.
nodes.altText: You monster.

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the minion you sacrifice is your only active minion.
nodes.nodeDescription: [35%] increased damage per point if the minion you sacrifice is your only active minion

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals additional fire damage.
nodes.nodeDescription: Sacrifice deals [6] additional fire damage per point

nodes.description: Sacrifice costs less mana and if you cast Sacrifice while you control at least one minion you gain a buff that grants you more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). This buff does not stack.
nodes.nodeDescription: [13%] increased mana efficiency per point. You deal [13%] increased damage over time if you have cast sacrifice in the past 4 seconds.

nodes.description: Sacrifice has a chance to ignite enemies and ignites it inflicts have additional fire penetration.
nodes.nodeDescription: [34%] chance to ignite on hit per point

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: [20%] more damage against bleeding enemies per point

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.
nodes.nodeDescription: Sacrifice deals [1.5%] increased damage per point for each minion you currently control
nodes.altText: At 3 points invested, you would reach the maximum possible benefit from this node at 20 minions.

nodes.description:
When you sacrifice a minion you have a chance to assemble a {Blood Spectre} from the remains. 15 mana is consumed when you summon a Blood Spectre. 

You cannot summon a Blood Spectre by sacrificing a Blood Spectre or when your mana is negative and below -100.
nodes.altText: {Blood Spectres} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

nodes.description: {Blood Spectres} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. Blood Spectres consume less mana when summoned.
nodes.altText: {Blood Spectres} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

nodes.description: {Blood Spectres} summoned by Sacrifice have more maximum health and deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: {Blood Spectres} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

nodes.description:
Sacrificing a minion always creates a {Blood Spectre}.

Blood Spectres summoned by Sacrifice have significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and are larger, but consume more mana when summoned.
{Blood Spectres} leech a portion of the damage they deal as health. Sacrifice has a greater chance to summon a Blood Spectre.
nodes.altText: {Blood Spectres} have a base of 100 health, decay over time, and use melee attacks.

nodes.description: Sacrificing a minion creates a {Bone Nova} around it, but Sacrifice costs more mana.
nodes.nodeDescription: 20% increased mana cost. Sacrificing a minion also creates a bone nova around the minion. Enemies hit by the initial blast of the sacrifice cannot be hit by the bone nova, but the shards of bone from the nova do travel further out and can hit enemies outside the range of the initial blast.

nodes.description: {Bone Nova} has increased area of effect.
nodes.nodeDescription: Bone Nova's projectiles travel [25%] faster and further per point.

nodes.description: {Bone Nova} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.nodeDescription: Bone Nova deals [25%] increased damage per point

nodes.description: {Bone Nova} has a chance to slow enemies hit.
nodes.nodeDescription: Bone Nova's projectiles pierce through enemies

nodes.description: {Bone Nova} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
nodes.nodeDescription: Bone Nova has a [25%] chance to cause bleeding per point

nodes.description: You deal increased damage over time if you have cast Sacrifice recently (past 4 seconds). You cannot have multiple instances of this buff at once.
nodes.nodeDescription: When you cast sacrifice you deal [20%] increased damage over time per point for 4 seconds. You cannot have multiple instances of this buff at once.

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.
nodes.nodeDescription: [20%] increased area of effect and stun chance per point

nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you have three or more minions active when you cast Sacrifice.
nodes.nodeDescription: [40%] increased area of effect per point, if you have three or more minions when you cast sacrifice.

nodes.description: Sacrifice is recast onto other minions within its area of effect, which can happen multiple times. Sacrifice costs more mana.
nodes.nodeDescription: 60% increased mana cost. Sacrifice chains between your minions. That is to say if a minion is within the area of the initial sacrifice it will also be sacrificed and minions within the area of that sacrifice will also be sacrifice and so on.

nodes.description: Sacrifice is recast onto other minions within its area of effect up to one additional time. It also has additional Bleed Chance.

If you cast Sacrifice while you control at least one minion all your active {Infernal Shades} have their remaining duration reduced to 2 seconds, but deal significantly more damage for their remaining duration.
nodes.altText:
This damage bonus stacks. The stacks are not multiplicative with each other, but are multiplicative with other modifiers.

This only affects Infernal Shades' regular damage over time effect, not any ailments they apply or sub skills they trigger.

Infernal Shades that have less than 2 seconds remaining duration do not have their duration changed, but still gain the damage bonus.

nodes.nodeDescription: Increases the attack and cast speed of all nearby allies.

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts longer.
nodes.nodeDescription: [15%] more health and duration per point.

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem affects allies or enemies in a larger area.
nodes.nodeDescription: Increases Frenzy Totem's area of effect by [20%] per point.

nodes.description: While in range of your Frenzy Totem, you have a chance to cast {Eterra's Blessing} on a random ally each second.
nodes.nodeDescription: While in range of the totem, you have a [5%] chance per point to cast Eterra’s Blessing on a random ally every second.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Eterra's Blessing While In Range

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem stores a portion of the damage it receives, releasing it as damage dealt to enemies after taking a percent of its maximum health in damage.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Frenzy Totem stores [2%] of damage it takes per point, releasing it as damage after taking [20%] of its health per point. 

The damage is scaled by your increased minion damage.
nodes.altText: The damage is scaled by your increased minion damage.

stats.statName: Percentage Of Max Health Taken Before Releasing

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem also stores a percentage of the damage taken by you.
nodes.nodeDescription: Frenzy Totem also stores [1%] of damage taken by you per point.

stats.statName: Percent Of Player Damage Taken Stored By Totem

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem has a chance to cast {Ice Thorns} when hit by enemies.
nodes.nodeDescription: Frenzy Totem has a [5%] chance per point to cast Ice Thorns when hit.

nodes.description:
Frenzy Totem is now {Sloth Totem,} which will now slow and reduce the armor of enemies instead of granting Frenzy.

Increased effect of frenzy is converted to increased effect of armor shred.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Frenzy Totem is now Sloth Totem. Sloth Totem will inflict Slow and armour shred upon enemies instead of granting Frenzy to allies. 

Increased effect of Frenzy is converted to increased effect of armour shred.

nodes.description:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor; instead it is always placed 1 meter in the direction you're facing.

Frenzy Totem costs less mana and grants additional melee damage.
nodes.nodeDescription:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor. Instead it is always placed 1 metre in the direction you aim. 

Frenzy Totem grants +[5] melee physical damage per point and has [10%] reduced mana cost per point.

stats.statName: Frenzy Totem Summoned 1m In Front Of Player

nodes.description: You are tethered to the totem while you remain within 5 meters of it, and while tethered you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: The range of the tether is not affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem's tether has a higher range.
You have additional critical strike multiplier while tethered.
nodes.nodeDescription: You have [50%] increased critical strike chance per point while Tethered.

nodes.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted increased health regeneration.
nodes.nodeDescription: Allies near the totem have [25%] increased health regen per point.

nodes.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, you and your companions are granted {Haste} for a duration (doubled for companions).
nodes.nodeDescription: When you summon a frenzy totem you and your companions gain Haste for [1] second[s] per point (duration doubled for companions).

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem's buffs are more effective, but Frenzy Totem now affects only companions.
nodes.nodeDescription: Frenzy Totem affects only companions. The buffs it grants are increased by [30%] per point.

nodes.description: Companions affected by Frenzy Totem have higher physical and elemental resistance.
nodes.nodeDescription: Companions in range have [50%] increased armour and protections per point.

nodes.description: While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.
nodes.nodeDescription: Downed companions are revived [30%] faster per point when in range of Frenzy Totem.

nodes.description: Whenever you revive a downed companion, Frenzy Totem casts {Healing Nova.}
nodes.nodeDescription: When a downed companion is revived, Frenzy Totem casts healing nova.
nodes.altText: The area of the Healing Nova is affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

stats.statName: Healing Nova Cast When Companion Is Revived

nodes.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted a chance to poison enemies.
nodes.nodeDescription: Allies near the totem have +[10%] chance to poison on hit per point.

nodes.description: Frenzy Totem's Frenzy buff is more effective.
When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.
nodes.nodeDescription: When you summon Frenzy Totem, for 4 seconds you gain [15%] increased damage and crititcal strike chance per point, but have [15%] reduced armor and protections per point.

nodes.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, your companions are granted additional melee physical damage for 4 seconds.
nodes.nodeDescription: When you summon Frenzy Totem your companions gain +[4] melee physical damage per point for 4 seconds.

nodes.description: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.
nodes.nodeDescription: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.
