nodes.nodeDescription: Sabertooth's Flurry Swipes casts an additional time when used.

nodes.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Wolves' howls also grant increased critical strike chance to you and your allies.
nodes.nodeDescription: Wolves' howls also grant [50%] increased critical strike chance per point.

stats.statName: Increased Critical Strike Chance Granted By Wolf Howl

nodes.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Scorpion's {Venom Nova} hits in a larger area.

nodes.nodeDescription:
Transform into a Spriggan and gain 4 new skills.
Mana doesn’t recharge and the skill ends when your mana runs out.

nodes.description: {Vines} deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
You now have a chance to summon a new Vine next to a nearby enemy when a {Vine} dies. Vines have increased attack and cast speed.

stats.statName: Summon Vine Chance On Vine Death

nodes.description:
After using Summon Vine, Human Form is now replaced with {Infestation}, which converts your 2 nearest {Vines} into {Hives} and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

Your {Vines} have a chance to grant you {Rage} on hit. Melee hits have a higher chance to grant Rage than spell hits.

If you have the {Great Vine} node the rage gained is 200% higher.

stats.statName: Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Melee Hit
Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Spell Hit

nodes.description:
You can now only summon 1 {Vine} at a time up to a maximum of 6, but they have significantly more health, size, threat generation and their melee attacks deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

Indirect casts only create a vine on every third cast.

You now have a chance to also cast Thorn Shield on the nearest {Vine} when you cast Thorn Shield. Other allies with Thorn Shield deal global increased physical damage and have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Thorn Shield On Nearest Vine

nodes.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
{Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

stats.statName: Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Thorn Shield

nodes.description: You have additional armor and increased armor while in Spriggan Form.
Thorn Shield lasts longer.
Thorn Shield grants additional armor and increased armor.
Thorn Shield can now only target you and can no longer attach to other allies.
nodes.altText: This doesn't affect the Thorn Shield cast on other allies from the {Voice of the Thicket} node in the {Werebear} skill tree.

stats.statName: Thorn Shield Can Only Target You

nodes.description: Thorn Shield has a chance to recast itself on the same target when it expires.
Thorn Shield reflects additional flat damage to attackers.

After directly casting Thorn Shield, Human Form is now replaced with {Bark Skin}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.
You gain ward equal to your armor when you enter Spriggan Form.

You summon an additional {Spriggan} when you enter Spriggan Form which doesn't count towards your Spriggan limit, but does count towards your companion limit.

You will not summon an additional Spriggan if you are already at your maximum companion limit.
nodes.altText: Spriggan summoned this way disappears when you exit Spriggan Form.

nodes.description: Your {Healing Totems} have more health and duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have increased summoning speed while in Spriggan Form.
Healing Totems directly cast from this tree now also shoot thorns. {Thorn Totem's} skill tree, mana cost, cooldown and totem limit also apply to Healing Totems.

stats.statName: Thorn Totem Tree Benefits Healing Totems

nodes.description: You now always summon 3 Healing Totems and you can have additional maximum Healing Totems.
Healing Totems have increased healing effectiveness.
Healing Totems are converted to Fury Totems and now restore {Rage} instead of healing, but can only affect you.
nodes.altText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.description: You now have a chance to cast Spirit Thorns from each of your Healing Totems when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.
Spirit Thorns and Thorn Shield deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
You gain {Rage} and ward when you directly cast Spirit Thorns and hit at least 1 enemy.
Spirit Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit) and they penetrate enemy physical and cold resistance.

stats.statName: Spirit Thorns Physical And Cold Penetration

nodes.description: You now summon a {Vale Spirit} every 5 direct casts with Spirit Thorns, up to a maximum.

stats.statName: Vale Spirit Every 5 Spirit Thorn Casts

nodes.description: Your Healing Totems have a chance to summon a {Vale Spirit} when they die.

stats.statName: Vale Spirit Chance On Healing Totem Death

nodes.description:
When you directly cast Spirit Thorns while at maximum Vale Spirits, you consume them to cast {Entangling Roots} at the target area and you regain {Rage}, which deals more damage when cast this way (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost.

stats.statName: Cast Entangling Roots With Spirit Thorns

nodes.description: You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} on you when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.
Your hits have a chance to poison enemies while in Spriggan Form and your Vines have a chance to poison enemies.

Spirit Thorns, Summon Vines and Thorn Shield's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for all three skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

Your {Vines} now cast thorns from range, instead of using a melee attack. This is affected by nodes on this tree that affects Spirit Thorns, but they only fire 1 projectile and {Great Vine} fires 3 projectiles.

stats.statName: Melee Attack -> Ranged Thorns For Vines

nodes.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Shadow Rend deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
Shadows consumed by {Shadow Massacre} have a chance to manifest a new shadow afterwards, based on their distance from you. Maximum effect is reached for shadows that are at least 6 meters away.
Each shadow consumed by {Shadow Massacre} or {Hidden Strength} restores health based on your dexterity.
You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when you directly use Shadow Rend and hit at least one enemy with the shadow's attack.
The manifested shadow chooses a random enemy to dash toward, ignoring your targeted direction. It can target enemies that are further away.
For every {Dusk Shroud} on you up to 20, the shadow's attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants ward if it hits at least one enemy.
Shadow Rend has additional chance to inflict bleed on hit, doubled for the shadow's attack.

stats.statName: Bleed Chance, Doubled for Shadow Attack

nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike chance.
Shadow Rend has additional chance to shock enemies on hit, and it has additional critical strike multiplier per shock on the enemy.
Shadow Rend has additional critical strike multiplier, and additional chance to blind enemies on hit.
The shadow's attack has a chance to inflict Shadow Daggers on hit.

stats.statName: Shadow Daggers Chance for Shadow Attack

nodes.description: Traversal skills consume all stacks of {Ghost Blades} over the course of their duration.

stats.statName: All Ghost Blades Stacks Consumed on Traversal

nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional physical penetration per unique negative ailment on the enemy, up to 5.
nodes.altText: This can be converted to lightning penetration by {Dusklight}.

stats.statName: Physical Penetration per Unique Negative Ailment

nodes.description: Directly using Shadow Rend grants Frenzy for a duration, and Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have frenzy.
While you are inside your {Smoke Bomb}, Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.
Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

Shadow Rend has increased melee area for the shadow's attack.

The shadow's attack has a chance to shred armor on hit, doubled with a bow.

stats.statName: Armor Shred Chance for Shadow Attack, Doubled with Bow

nodes.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes existing shadows to make them imitate Multishot or Shadow Cascade, depending on your equipped weapon type. Each Shadow Cascade or Multishot imitated consumes mana.

This node has no effect if {Hidden Strength} is allocated.

stats.statName: Shadows Imitate Multishot with a Bow
Shadows Imitate Shadow Cascade with a Melee Weapon

nodes.description: Shadow Rend no longer moves you. The manifested shadow dashes forward 5 meters in the targeted direction before attacking, and will choose a target within range upon arriving.
nodes.altText: {Shadow Rush} can still move you.

nodes.description:
Shadow Rend is now a traversal skill. You dash up to 7 meters forward after manifesting the shadow.

Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a cooldown.

Directly using Shadow Rend and hitting at least one enemy with the shadow's attack grants stacks of {Ghost Blades}, up to 9. Stacks of Ghost Blades are consumed 3 times per second while moving to throw a Ghost Blade at a nearby enemy.
nodes.altText: Ghost Blades ignore conversions from effects such as {Dusklight}.

stats.statName: Ghost Blade Stacks Consumed per Second While Moving

nodes.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Shadow Rend.

Shadow Rend deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison on the enemy, up to 30.

stats.statName: Hit Damage per Poison, up to 30

nodes.description: Shadow Rend deals more bow damage to damaged enemies. When used with a bow, Shadow Rend moves you forwards instead of backwards.
Shadow Rend has an additional charge.

You have a chance to throw {Shurikens} or {Umbral Blades} at a nearby enemy when you jump and when you land, consuming 70% of the skill's mana cost each time.

The skill chosen is your most recently directly used skill among them, or else random.

stats.statName: Chance to Throw Shurikens or Umbral Blades on Leap
Chance to Throw Shurikens or Umbral Blades on Land

nodes.description: Shadow Rend has a chance to inflict frailty and slow on hit.

Directly using Shadow Rend consumes all shadows. It restores mana if you consume at least 1 shadow.

For each shadow consumed after the first, it gains more damage and more melee area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
nodes.altText: For example with 1 point invested and 3 shadows consumed, you will restore 2 mana and Shadow Rend will gain 40% more damage and 20% more area.

stats.statName: Mana Restored from First Shadow Consumed
Melee Area from Subsequent Shadows Consumed

You have additional dodge chance per point of Dexterity for 1 second after Shifting.
Shifting heals you for a portion equal to your Dexterity. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.
Shifting cleanses all negative ailments on you.
If a single hit deals at least 50% of your health, Shift's cooldown is reset. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.
You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.
nodes.altText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.

nodes.description: You gain 50% increased movement speed for a brief moment after Shifting.

Using Shift grants you {Jade Arrows.} 

Using a bow attack consumes a {Jade Arrow} to have increased critical strike chance and a chance to poison enemies.

stats.statName: Jade Arrow Increased Critical Strike Chance

nodes.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also causes your next bow attack's critical strikes to deal more damage.
Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also grants your next bow attack increased damage over time.
Shift restores mana on use. This amount is tripled when below half health.
You are invulnerable while Shifting.
Shift consumes a health potion on use if you are below 50% health.
The next damaging non-channelled skill you use after Shifting is always a critical strike.

stats.statName: Always Crit With Next Non-Channelled Skill

nodes.description: If using a melee weapon, when Shifting you perform an {Unseen Strike}, hitting enemies along your path.
nodes.altText: Deals melee physical damage, with 100% added damage effectiveness.

nodes.description: You throw {Shurikens} at nearby enemies after Shifting.
nodes.altText: This will grant {Chakram} 10% more damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have the {Keen Throw} node.

nodes.description: {Unseen Strike} hits in a wider area.
You leave behind a {Shadow} at the place you Shifted from.
When the {Shadow} created by Shift is consumed, you return to its location.
After using Shift you use {Shadow Cascade}.
You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on arrival.
nodes.altText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.

nodes.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on departure.
nodes.altText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.

nodes.description: Shift has a shorter cooldown and costs less mana.
{Unseen Strike} has a chance to inflict {Shadow Dagger} to enemies hit.
{Unseen Strike} slows enemies it hits.

{Unseen Strike} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.altText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.

nodes.nodeDescription:
Summons a sigil that orbits you, causing you and your allies' attacks and spells to deal 4 additional fire damage and increasing  health regeneration by 25%.

You can have up to 3 sigils at a time. Sigils expire after 15 seconds.

nodes.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies increased mana regeneration.
Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies additional chance to electrify on hit.
Symbols grant you and your allies a chance to ignite enemies.
You and your allies gain increased critical strike chance per Symbol.
Symbols grant you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.
nodes.nodeDescription: You and your allies have [6%] increased healing effectiveness per point per active Sigil.

nodes.description: Symbols of Hope costs less mana and the active effect lasts longer.
You can summon an additional Symbol.
nodes.nodeDescription: +1 Max Sigils. Does not override Symbol of Solitude.

nodes.description: When you activate Symbols of Hope, gain ward equal to a portion of your maximum health per symbol consumed.

stats.statName: Portion Of Health To Ward Per Symbol

Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants increased healing effectiveness for its duration.
Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants Haste for its duration.
